newsitem.title: ANTIGUA: CRICKET-W.INDIES V INDIA, FOURTH TEST TOSS/TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-W.INDIES V INDIA, FOURTH TEST TOSS/TEAMS.

text.p: West Indies won the toss and decided to bat on the fourth day of the fourth test against India on Monday.
Play finally got underway after the first three day were washed out.
West Indies made one change from the third test, captain Courtney Walsh returning from injury to replace Mervyn Dillon.
India made two changes, Ajay Jadeja and Sunil Joshi coming in for Navjot Sidhu and Dodanarsiah Ganesh.
West Indies -Sherwin Campbell, Stuart Williams, Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Brian Lara, Carl Hooper, Roland Holder, Courtney Browne, Curtly Ambrose, Franklyn Rose, Ian Bishop, Courtney Walsh (captain).
India - VVS Laxman, Ajay Jadeja, Rahul Dravid, Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, Mohammad Azharuddin, Nayan Mongia, Anil Kumble, Sunil Joshi, Abey Kuruvilla, Venkatesh Prasad.
